habitat: 제주도의 상록활엽수림, 숲이 우거진 수목원과 공원

months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이며, 2019년 이후 제주에서 주로 11–2월에 관찰된다.

summary: 2013년 5월 신안 가거도에서 처음 확인된 길잃은새로 분류되어 있으나, 2019년 이후 제주도의 상록활엽수림과 수목원·공원에서 주로 겨울에 관찰이 이어지고 있다. 본래 일본 류큐 열도에만 살았으나 1970년대부터 규슈로 퍼져 시코쿠와 혼슈 서부까지 사는 곳을 넓혔다. 상록활엽수림을 비롯한 숲에 살며, 녹지가 많은 시가지나 정원에서도 지낸다.

art.subject: Ryukyu Minivet (Pericrocotus tegimae), adult male: a narrow white band on the forehead; crown, nape, lores and ear-coverts black; chin and throat white, the white curving up behind the black ear-coverts onto the sides of the neck; mantle, back and rump dark grey, clearly darker than Ashy Minivet's, so they contrast less with the black crown; wings blackish; a grey wash across the breast, darkest at the sides and continuing down the flanks; belly and undertail coverts white; tail long, blackish with white on the outer feathers. Bill and legs black.
art.pose: perched on an outer branch in the canopy, side view
art.scene: Evergreen broadleaf forest canopy on Jeju Island in early summer, soft light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched on an outer canopy branch: slim upright minivet, narrow white forehead band, black crown, nape and ear-coverts, white throat, dark grey back and rump, blackish wings, dark grey wash across the breast and down the flanks, white belly, long blackish tail with a little white on the outer feathers

adult female, side view perched on a canopy branch: same slim shape, grey crown and nape with almost no white forehead band, dark lores, white throat, grey back, grey wash on the breast and flanks, white belly, long blackish tail
art.build: Slim, long-tailed minivet, about the size of Ashy Minivet but darker overall: a little larger than a sparrow in body with a much longer tail; flat-topped head and upright posture in the canopy. Bill short, black, slightly hooked. Legs short, black. Tail long and graduated. Moves through evergreen broadleaf forest canopy in pairs or small groups. Females are duller and greyer on the head, with less contrast.
avoid: Do not paint a broad white forehead, a pale grey back and a clean white breast; those mark Ashy Minivet (Pericrocotus divaricatus).
Do not paint any red, orange or yellow.
Do not leave the breast white; a grey wash runs across the breast and down the flanks, leaving only the belly white.
Do not paint a pale or mid-grey back sharply set off from the black crown (Ashy Minivet); the back is dark grey and contrasts only weakly with the crown and ear-coverts.
